info.description: Personal finance tracking: transactions, categories, dashboard and cash flow reports.
info.title: Financial Management API

parameters.description: CASH_FLOW, WALLET, BANK, CREDIT_CARD or SAVINGS
parameters.name: account_type

post.description:
Stores what the account really held on a day. Recording the same day twice
overwrites the figure. The gap against the recorded transactions is what the
daily report shows as spending that was never written down.

parameters.description: today, week, month, year or custom
parameters.name: range

get.description:
The same report the Telegram bot sends, as JSON. Sections with nothing to say are
omitted, and a wallet or bank only reports a variance once a balance has been
recorded for it.

parameters.description: Report date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: date

post.description:
Returns a short-lived single-use code. Send "/start <code>" to the bot from the
chat that should receive reports. Until a chat is paired the bot answers nothing.

parameters.description: Report date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: date

post.description:
Called by Telegram, not by clients. The X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header
must match TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET, so knowing the URL is not enough to post
forged updates.

computed.description: Computed is MoneyIn - Fees - MoneyOut: the day's own movement.

fees.description: Fees are direct charges on the account, such as a transfer fee.

previous_balance.description:
PreviousBalance is ActualBalance - Computed: what was already sitting there, which is
why the actual balance is not treated as a deduction from the wallet.

taken_back.description: TakenBack is money moved off the card into another account, the top-up source.

date.description: Date is the day the report covers.

date_label.description: DateLabel is the short day heading, e.g. "25/09".

period_label.description: PeriodLabel is the month heading, already localised, e.g. "SEPTEMBER 2026".

bot_username.description: BotUsername is empty when the bot token could not be reached.

deep_link.description:
DeepLink opens the chat and sends "/start <code>" on a single tap, so nothing has to be
typed. It is empty when the bot username is unknown, and the UI then falls back to
showing the code.

instruction.description:
Instruction is ready to show in the UI so the user does not have to be told the
command format separately.

characters.description:
Characters is the rendered length before splitting, useful when a report grows near
the 4096-character limit.

allocation_total.description: AllocationTotal sums Allocations; when it equals Total the section is balanced.

account_id.description:
AccountID is where the money moved. It is optional; a transaction without one is
treated as cash flow.

parent_id.description:
ParentID makes this row a detail line of another transaction, so the parent's amount
is reported once and its parts are still visible.

to_account_id.description: ToAccountID is the other side of a transfer and is only allowed on a TRANSFER.

allotment.description: Allotment is the total topped up into this wallet on the report date.

expected_remaining.description: ExpectedRemaining is Allotment - RecordedTotal: what should still be there.

has_actual_balance.description:
HasActualBalance is false when nobody counted the wallet, in which case the report
stops at ExpectedRemaining instead of inventing a variance.

recorded_total.description: RecordedTotal sums Items, counting a parent once and never its children.

variance.description: Variance is ExpectedRemaining - ActualBalance: spending that was never written down.

BearerAuth.description: Send the access token as: Bearer {token}
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
